ayahOccurrences.text: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَفْدًا is in the derivative form: وَفْدٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ف/د   w–f–d the fastest camel in a caravan; distinguished group of travellers, honoured group arriving at the residence of a high‐ranking person, an envoy between high‐ranking people; to arrive. Of this root, وَفْدٌ wafd, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
وَفْدٌ wafd [coll. n.] honoured company, a group who come into the presence of a high‐ranking person

(19:85) يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ وَفْدًا on the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy.
